summary: The game crashes when putting items with max stack sizes above 64 into bundles
description: The Bug: The game crashes when putting items with max stack sizes above 64 into bundles. A crash report regarding this has been attached and can be found below. Stack Trace: [^crash-2024-03-20_16.42.33-client.txt] Description: Container click java.lang.ArithmeticException: / by zero at cvk$a.c(SourceFile:134) at cvk$a.a(SourceFile:145) at crg.a(SourceFile:90) at csz.a(SourceFile:461) at cod.a(SourceFile:535) at cod.b(SourceFile:408) at cod.a(SourceFile:294) at fmq.a(SourceFile:370) at fmb.b(SourceFile:521) at fmq.b(SourceFile:606) at fdf.a(SourceFile:103) at fld.a(SourceFile:453) at fdf.a(SourceFile:103) at fdf.c(SourceFile:186) at boc.execute(SourceFile:108) at fdf.b(SourceFile:186) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFWMouseButtonCallbackI.callback(GLFWMouseButtonCallbackI.java:43) at org.lwjgl.system.JNI.invokeV(Native Method) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.glfwWaitEventsTimeout(GLFW.java:3509) at com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.limitDisplayFPS(SourceFile:236) at fde.c(SourceFile:1364) at fde.f(SourceFile:895) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:265) Steps to Reproduce: - Obtain a bundle. - Give yourself a diamond sword with a max stack size of 65 by using the command provided below. /give @s minecraft:diamond_sword[minecraft:max_stack_size=65] 1 - Put the diamond sword into the bundle. Observed Behavior: The game crashes. Expected Behavior: The game would not crash.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft and create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Obtain a bundle by placing a crafting table and using the recipe for bundles.
3. Use the following command to give yourself a diamond sword with a max stack size of 65: `/give @s minecraft:diamond_sword[minecraft:max_stack_size=65] 1`
4. Open your inventory and place the diamond sword into the bundle.
5. Observe that the game crashes when you attempt to put the diamond sword into the bundle.
Observed Behavior:
The game crashes when attempting to place items with a max stack size above 64 into bundles. To reproduce this issue, first obtain a bundle and then use the command `/give @s minecraft:diamond_sword[minecraft:max_stack_size=65] 1` to give yourself a diamond sword with a max stack size of 65. When you try to place this diamond sword into the bundle, the game crashes. The expected behavior is that the game should not crash under these conditions. A crash report has been attached for further reference and can be found below. The stack trace indicates an arithmetic exception due to division by zero during container click operations.

This detailed description provides clear steps to reproduce the issue and highlights the discrepancy between the observed and expected behaviors, which will help developers understand and address the problem effectively.
Expected Behavior: When following the steps to put a diamond sword with a max stack size of 65 into a bundle, the game should function normally without any crashes. The diamond sword should be successfully added to the bundle, and the player should be able to interact with it as expected within the inventory.
